Cc: AP Team <ap@orchidbiotech.com>
Date: Mon, 24 Jun 2029 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Outstanding split invoices — proposal to push one-time ACH

Hi Sophie,

Hope you're well — quick follow on INV-1183 and the associated split for the EMEA entity. Our billing shows a remaining balance of $42,300 across two entities (US/UK split). I wanted to propose a one-time ACH push from Orchid's bank to help clear the ledger this month and avoid a partial hold on usage.

Two options from our side:
- We can accept a single ACH covering the full amount into our consolidated US account (we'll allocate internally and send tax/VAT substantiation).
- If AP prefers, we can provide a secure DocuSign remit link to capture payment authorization and the bank token (for a one-time push).

Attached is the invoice and a short ACH instructions file for your AP team. If you need a split invoice by entity (separate tax lines), I can loop in Laura from finance to confirm VAT lines. Can you let me know which route AP prefers by EOD Wednesday?

Thanks —
Grace O'Connor
Head of Customer Success, Redwood Inference
grace.oconnor@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0128

Can Laura provide the VAT breakdown? Our standard policy also requires a signed authorization for one-time ACH (we can use your DocuSign link).

If splitting causes timing delays, we may be able to do an interim wire for the US portion and follow with an ACH for the remainder. What's the earliest you can provide the split invoice?

- ACH-Instructions.txt — our receiving account and US EIN.

2) Alternatively, initiate a wire for the US portion today and we will wait to collect the UK portion upon receipt of VAT proof.

Please confirm which option works and, if ACH, reply with the signed DocuSign (or I can re-send the link directly to AP). If you'd like a short mutual action plan I can create one in HubSpot (I attached the HubSpot record link).
